name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-reviewer-engagement
_comment: Reviewer-engagement per-reviewer reminder marker (docs/REVIEWER_ENGAGEMENT_SPEC.md §4 / §3.B). Fire-once marker for the respond-by reminder, SEPARATE from the review-due/follow-up marker. CRITICAL (Codex P2): Re-invite (allowResend) MUST clear this in the SAME write as the emailSentAt re-stamp in send-emails.js, or the prior wave's marker blocks the new window's reminder. schema-apply is creation-only + idempotent. Same DateAndTime/UserLocal shape as the existing wmkf_heldat / wmkf_responsereceivedat lifecycle timestamps. New field MUST carry NO PowerAutomate trigger — verify post-deploy. Catalogued in docs/atlas/dataverse-reviewer-suggestion.md (or the reviewer-suggestion Atlas page).

attributes.description: When the single respond-by reminder was sent to this reviewer (Phase 3 fire-once marker). Empty = not yet sent. Cleared on Re-invite so a fresh offer window can remind again.
